1.consolidated_definition: inform. Interfaz. Dispositivo electrónico que permite el diálogo entre distintos elementos de un sistema informático o de dos sistemas independientes. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Se trata de describir las caracteristica basicas de la interface de los sistemas operativos (Universidad Interamericana, febrero 2007)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Interface. Electronic device that enables dialogue between different components of a computer system or between two independent systems. Anglicism, common in informal contexts. It describes the basic characteristics of an operating system's interface (University Interamericana, February 2007)
